name: Hyprland
summary: Dynamic tiling Wayland compositor with animations, rounded corners and gradient borders. Since 0.55 it is configured in Lua (hyprland.lua); the older hyprlang hyprland.conf is deprecated. Layouts: dwindle, master, scrolling, monocle.

install.notes: Arch extra repository, tagged releases. The wiki advises against -git packages.
No official Fedora package; the wiki lists the lionheartp/Hyprland Copr (dnf copr enable lionheartp/Hyprland). Community-maintained.
Debian 14 (forky) or 13 (trixie) via trixie-backports; Ubuntu 24.10 and 26.04 via the universe repo (the wiki calls Ubuntu's packages extremely outdated). Not available on Debian 12.

linux.notes: Latest tag at verification: v0.57.2 (2026-11-09). 0.55+ reads hyprland.lua when it exists; hyprland.conf (hyprlang) is deprecated (the exact fallback behaviour is inferred from the 0.55 notes 'use lua if available' and the 'hyprctl reload full-reset' lua/hyprlang switch). 0.54 and older read only hyprland.conf and use windowrule = ..., match:class ... (0.53+) or windowrulev2 (older). Recipes show Lua first and give the hyprlang line where it differs. No standalone config validator is documented: save or reload, then run hyprctl configerrors. Start from a display manager session or the start-hyprland wrapper (otherwise a watchdog warning shows). NVIDIA GPUs need extra setup, see the wiki.
